scripts.start: concurrently -k -n sim,brain -c blue,magenta "npm run start --workspace=apps/sim" "npm run start --workspace=apps/brain"
scripts.search:start: docker run -d --name ampli-searxng --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:8888:8080 -v "$PWD/tools/searxng:/etc/searxng" -e SEARXNG_SECRET=$(openssl rand -hex 16) searxng/searxng:latest && echo "SearXNG running at http://localhost:8888 (set SEARXNG_URL=http://localhost:8888 in .env)"
